scripts.release-minor: npm run clean && npm run build-prod && npm run publish-packages -- minor
scripts.release-major: npm run clean && npm run build-prod && npm run publish-packages -- major
scripts.release-patch: npm run clean && npm run build-prod && npm run publish-packages -- patch
scripts.pre-release-major: npm run clean && npm run build-prod
scripts.pre-release-minor: npm run clean && npm run build-prod
scripts.pre-release-patch: npm run clean && npm run build-prod
scripts.trash: ./scripts/trash.sh && turbo run clean && npm run bootstrap
